ourMissionText: To provide travelers with seamless access to quality accommodations worldwide, while supporting local hospitality businesses and creating memorable experiences.

faq1Q: How do I make a booking?
faq1A: Browse our hotels, select your preferred accommodation, choose dates, and click "Book Now". Follow the checkout process to complete your reservation.
faq2A: Cancellation policies vary by hotel. Check the specific hotel's cancellation policy before booking. You can manage your bookings from the Purchase History page.
faq3Q: How do I change my account settings?
faq3A: Click on your name in the header, then select "Settings" from the dropdown menu. You can update your profile information and change your password there.
faq4Q: What payment methods do you accept?
faq4A: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express) and PayPal for secure online payments.
faq5Q: How can I contact a hotel directly?
faq5A: Visit the hotel details page and scroll down to find the contact information section with phone number and email address.

privacySubtitle: How we protect and handle your personal data
privacyIntro: At Petoria, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and share your personal information when you use our platform. By using our services, you agree to the practices described herein.
privacySection1Text: We collect several types of information to provide and improve our services. This includes personal identification data (name, email address, phone number), account credentials, payment information (processed securely by our payment partners), booking history and preferences, technical data such as IP address, browser type, device identifiers, and usage data about how you interact with our platform. We collect this information when you register an account, make a booking, contact our support team, or simply browse our website.
privacySection2Text: We use your personal data to process and manage your hotel bookings, create and maintain your account, send booking confirmations, updates, and important notifications, personalize your experience and show relevant recommendations, process payments and prevent fraudulent transactions, respond to your inquiries and provide customer support, improve our platform, develop new features, and conduct analytics, and comply with our legal obligations. We do not sell your personal information to third parties for their own marketing purposes.
privacySection3Text: We take the security of your data seriously and implement a range of technical and organisational measures to protect it. All data transmitted between your browser and our servers is encrypted using industry-standard TLS/SSL technology. Sensitive data such as passwords are hashed using secure algorithms and never stored in plain text. Payment information is processed through PCI-DSS compliant payment processors and we do not store full card numbers on our systems. We also limit access to personal data to employees who need it for legitimate business purposes and conduct regular security audits.
privacySection4Text: We may share your information with trusted third parties only to the extent necessary to deliver our services. This includes hotel partners to fulfil your booking, payment processors to handle transactions securely, analytics providers to help us understand how our platform is used, and email service providers to send you transactional messages. All third parties we work with are contractually required to handle your data in compliance with applicable data protection laws. We may also disclose your information if required to do so by law or in response to a valid legal request.
privacySection5Text: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience on Petoria. Essential cookies are necessary for the website to function properly and cannot be disabled. Preference cookies remember your settings such as language and currency. Analytics cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our site so we can improve it. Marketing cookies may be used to show you relevant advertisements on other platforms. You can manage your cookie preferences at any time through your browser settings or our cookie banner. Disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of the platform.
privacySection6Text: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data: the right to access the personal information we hold about you, the right to correct inaccurate or incomplete data, the right to request deletion of your personal data (subject to legal obligations), the right to restrict or object to certain processing, the right to data portability, and the right to withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at petooriaa@gmail.com. We will respond to your request within 30 days.
privacySection7Text: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes outlined in this policy, or as required by applicable law. Account information is kept for the duration of your account's existence and for a reasonable period afterwards. Booking records are retained for a minimum of 7 years to meet legal and tax obligations. Server logs and analytics data are typically retained for up to 12 months. When data is no longer needed, we securely delete or anonymise it so it can no longer be associated with you.
privacySection8Text: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or the way we handle your personal data, please do not hesitate to get in touch. You can reach our Data Protection team by email at petooriaa@gmail.com or by writing to us at: Petoria Ltd., 47 Vitosha Boulevard, Sofia 1000, Bulgaria. We take every concern seriously and will do our best to address your enquiry promptly and transparently.
privacyContactText: Our team is ready to help you with any privacy-related questions or requests.

termsIntro: Welcome to Petoria. By accessing or using our website, mobile application, or any of our services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you disagree with any part of these terms, you may not access our services. These terms apply to all visitors, users, and others who access or use our platform.
termsSection1Text: By creating an account or using Petoria's services, you confirm that you are at least 18 years of age, that you have read and understood these Terms of Service, and that you agree to be legally bound by them. If you are using our services on behalf of an organisation, you represent that you have the authority to bind that organisation to these terms. Petoria reserves the right to update these terms at any time. Continued use of the platform after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the new terms.
termsSection2Text: To access certain features of our platform, you must register for an account. You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information during registration, to maintain and promptly update your account information, to keep your password confidential and not share it with any third party, to notify us immediately upon becoming aware of any breach of security or unauthorised use of your account, and to accept full responsibility for all activities that occur under your account. Petoria reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or that have been inactive for an extended period.
termsSection3Text: Petoria acts as an intermediary platform connecting travellers with hotel partners. When you make a booking through our platform, you enter into a direct contractual relationship with the hotel. Petoria is not a party to that contract. We are not responsible for the quality, safety, or accuracy of hotel listings, nor for any disputes between guests and hotels. All booking details, including availability, pricing, and cancellation policies, are provided by the hotels. You are responsible for reading and understanding the hotel's specific terms and cancellation policy before completing any booking.
termsSection4Text: All prices displayed on the platform are in the currency shown and include applicable taxes unless otherwise stated. Payment must be made in full at the time of booking unless otherwise specified. We accept major credit and debit cards as well as PayPal. Currency conversions are provided for indicative purposes only; the actual amount charged may vary based on your bank's exchange rate. In the event of a pricing error, Petoria reserves the right to cancel the affected booking and provide a full refund. Petoria uses industry-standard encryption for all financial transactions.
termsSection5Text: Cancellation policies vary by hotel and room type and are clearly displayed on each listing page before booking. Some bookings may be non-refundable. If a booking qualifies for cancellation, refunds will be processed to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. Petoria's service fees, if applicable, are generally non-refundable. In cases where a hotel fails to honour a confirmed reservation, Petoria will work with you to find an alternative or arrange a full refund. Petoria is not liable for any indirect costs arising from cancellations, such as travel or visa expenses.
termsSection6Text: You agree not to use the Petoria platform for any unlawful purpose or in any way that could harm, disable, or impair the service. Specifically, you must not attempt to gain unauthorised access to any part of the platform, post false, misleading, or fraudulent reviews or content, use automated tools to scrape or extract data from the platform, impersonate any person or entity or misrepresent your affiliation with any person or entity, engage in any activity that disrupts or interferes with the platform's functionality, or use the platform to send spam or unsolicited commercial messages. cookiesSubtitle: How we use cookies and similar technologies on our platform
cookiesIntro: Petoria uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience, analyse site traffic, personalise content, and serve targeted advertisements. This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, which types we use, and how you can control them.
cookieTypeEssentialDesc: Strictly necessary for the website to function. They enable core features like page navigation, secure login, and shopping cart. Cannot be disabled.
cookieTypeAnalyticsDesc: Help us understand how visitors interact with our site by collecting and reporting information anonymously, so we can improve performance.
cookieTypeFunctionalDesc: Remember your preferences such as language, currency, and theme to provide a more personalised and convenient experience.
cookieTypeMarketingDesc: Used to track visitors across websites to display relevant advertisements that match your interests on third-party platforms.
cookiesSection1Text: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device (computer, tablet, or mobile phone) when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and to provide information to website owners. Cookies do not contain personally identifiable information, but some may be linked to personal data we hold about you. When you visit Petoria, our server sends a cookie to your browser, which stores the cookie on your device. Our server can read the cookie the next time you visit.
cookiesSection2Text: We use cookies for a variety of purposes, including to keep you signed in to your account, remember your search preferences and filters, save your language and currency settings, understand which pages are most popular and how users navigate our site, measure the effectiveness of our marketing campaigns, detect and prevent fraudulent activity, and ensure the security of our platform. Some of these cookies are set by us, and others are set by our trusted third-party partners such as Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, and payment processors.
cookiesSection3Text: Some cookies on our platform are placed by third-party service providers. These include analytics providers such as Google Analytics, which help us understand how our platform is used; social media platforms such as Facebook and Twitter, which enable sharing features; payment processors such as Stripe, which handle secure transactions; and advertising networks that deliver relevant promotional content. We do not have direct control over third-party cookies, and they are subject to the privacy and cookie policies of those third parties. We encourage you to review those policies.
cookiesSection4Text: Cookies can be either session cookies or persistent cookies. Session cookies are temporary and are deleted from your device when you close your browser. They are used to maintain your session, for example to keep you logged in as you navigate between pages. Persistent cookies remain on your device for a set period, or until you delete them manually. They are used to remember your preferences across visits, for example your language and currency settings. Petoria uses both session and persistent cookies, with persistent cookies having lifespans ranging from a few days to up to two years depending on their purpose.
cookiesSection5Text: You have several options for controlling cookies. You can use the consent banner shown when you first visit our site to accept all cookies or only essential ones. You can also click the 'Reset Cookie Preferences' button on this page to reset your consent and see the banner again. Additionally, most browsers allow you to view, delete, and block cookies through their settings. Common browsers handle this under Settings > Privacy or Settings > Cookies. Please note that blocking certain cookies may affect the functionality of our website and some features may not work as expected.
cookiesSection6Text: If you have any questions about our use of cookies or this Cookie Policy, please contact our privacy team at petooriaa@gmail.com or write to us at: Petoria Ltd., 47 Vitosha Boulevard, Sofia 1000, Bulgaria. We are happy to answer any questions you may have.
